Aisha K: FYI — Stripe opened a dispute for txn `ch_1JH9x2Yz` on customer account redwood-corp for $12,450.00. Reason: "card_not_present / duplicate". Need evidence bundle by EOD.
Tom L: Can you paste the dispute id and the original invoice? Also last4 and descriptor pls.
Aisha K: dispute_id: `dp_3Kf4z9`. Invoice: INV-2026-0318-119. Last4: 4242. Descriptor: REDWOOD*INFER
billing-bot: New webhook received from payments (stripe). payload_id=wh_20260318_8792, txn=ch_1JH9x2Yz, amount=1245000, currency=usd, status=disputed
Tom L: Ok thanks. @Sofia P can you pull the signed TOS and payment method tokenization logs? Need AVS, IP, and device fingerprint if available.
Sofia P: On it. Pulling from payments-logs S3. I’ll redact card PAN. ETA 30m.
Riley M: Suggest we put the account on temporary billing hold until evidence compiled. Risk flag: potential stolen card + duplicate charge pattern.
Aisha K: Agreed on hold. @Tom L please confirm hold with PM/CS so customers aren't surprised.
Tom L: Pinged CS via DM. Also need server-side API logs showing the order creation -> charge id mapping. If we have a duplicate webhook or retry, that helps.
Sofia P: Found two order records close in time: order_7643 (2026-03-18T14:22:11Z) and order_7643-retry (2026-03-18T14:22:13Z). Looks like double-submit from client. Saving logs to s3://redwood-evidence/disputes/dp_3Kf4z9/evidence_bundle.zip
Sofia P: curl to fetch (internal): ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SECRET" "https://internal-logs.redwood/api/charges?txn=ch_1JH9x2Yz" > ch_1JH9x2Yz.log``` 
Tom L: Good capture. Please include card AVS result: `Y` or `N`, and the IP address + geo. Also include CS payment confirmation email if sent.
Sofia P: AVS=Y, IP=18.205.23.112 (us-east-1; AWS), customer email confirmation sent at 2026-03-18T14:22:20Z. Adding screenshots of the invoice and email headers to the bundle.
Aisha K: Nice. Any evidence of duplicate capture on our end? transaction meta shows `retry_count=1` and `client_request_id` different but identical payload hash. Looks like client retried the submit quickly.
Riley M: For dispute response, we'll argue merchant error/duplicate billing but include proof of capture and delivery (if applicable). If duplicate, ask Stripe to reverse one charge instead of full chargeback.
Tom L: I'll draft the dispute response. Need csv of transactions and a short timeline. Sofia, can you export a timeline file? 
Sofia P: Timeline CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/disputes/dp_3Kf4z9/timeline.csv
Aisha K: Quick note — customer support notes show they contacted us at 2026-03-18T15:05Z saying order received. That helps us prove goods delivered.
billing-bot: Dispute update: status -> under_review. Due_by: 2026-03-25
Tom L: Draft done and attached to the ticket. Submitting now to Stripe via support portal with the evidence bundle.
Aisha K: Thanks team. If Stripe still decides chargeback, finance will coordinate chargeback reversal process and update revenue recognition.
Riley M: Marking as risk:resolved?pending_stripe. I'll remove the billing hold once we confirm duplicate refund or dispute outcome.
Sofia P: Leaving the evidence bundle link in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
Tom L: Closing thread here — follow-ups will be in the dispute ticket dp_3Kf4z9.
